definitions.explanation: A determined or persistent attitude, refusing to give in.
A sense of self-respect that prevents yielding to others.

examples.japanese: {意地|いじ}{悪|わる}なことを{言|い}う。
{意地|いじ}でも{諦|あきら}めない。
examples.english: I won't give up no matter what.

examples.japanese: {男|おとこ}の{意地|いじ}を{見|み}せた。
{意地|いじ}にかけても{負|ま}けたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to lose, as a matter of pride.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}たちは{意地|いじ}のぶつかり{合|あ}いで{最後|さいご}まで{戦|たたか}った。
examples.english: The players fought to the end in a clash of pride.

examples.japanese: {意地|いじ}の{悪|わる}い{人|ひと}だ。
あの{子|こ}は{食|く}い{意地|いじ}が{張|は}っている。
examples.english: That child is greedy for food.
examples.notes: {食|く}い{意地|いじ} = greediness for food

examples.japanese: {意地|いじ}の{悪|わる}い{質問|しつもん}をされて、{答|こた}えに{困|こま}った。
examples.english: I was asked a spiteful question and struggled to answer.

notes:
{意地|いじ} relates to stubbornness, pride, or disposition.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意地|いじ}を{張|は}る (to be stubborn)
- {意地|いじ}が{悪|わる}い (mean-spirited)
- {意地|いじ}でも (no matter what, stubbornly)
- {意地|いじ}になる (to become stubborn)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {意地悪|いじわる}: meanness, spite
- {食|く}い{意地|いじ}: gluttony, greediness for food

NOTE:
- Different from {維持|いじ} (maintenance) - same reading, different kanji
